quantization: 4-bit NF4 language layers; bfloat16 vision/projector/output layers
prompt: Describe this figure in at most 90 words using only visible evidence. For a chart, state the axes, legend categories, colors and overall trend. For a diagram, describe the labeled components and visible arrows. Do not invent missing labels, numeric values, comparisons or explanations. If text is unreadable, say so.
policy: extracted caption first; Granite only when no nonempty caption resolves
